title: Bangladesh Goes To Polls In First National Election Since July 2024 Uprising That Ended Hasina Rule
text: Bangladesh Goes To Polls In First National Election Since July 2024 Uprising That Ended Hasina RuleBangladesh began voting on Wednesday in key national elections, the first since the July 2024 uprising that ended former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina’s 15-year rule. The Muhammad Yunus-led interim government said it is committed to free, fair and peaceful polls, with around 500 foreign observers, including the European Union and the Commonwealth, monitoring the process. #timesnow #englishnews #bangladesh #elections #sheikhhasina #muhammadyunus #uprising #democracy #vote #world Times Now - Times Now News channel examines news with in-depth analysis.
